categories.main_business_segments: Qingdao Daneng Environmental Protection Equipment Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the design, manufacturing, installation, and sales of energy-saving and environmental protection equipment. Its main product lines include slag energy-saving environmental treatment systems (dry and wet slag systems), flue gas energy-saving environmental treatment systems, clean energy consumption systems, desulfurization wastewater treatment systems, and steel slag treatment systems. The company also provides related spare parts and technical consulting services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes proprietary technologies such as axial chain transmission, scaly conveyor belt technology, closed self-cleaning technology, penetrating cooling technology, quantitative air control, large slag separation and crushing, graded cooling slag discharge systems, and vacuum dewatering. It has developed advanced systems like the smoke-water dual isolation phase-change flue gas deep cooler and steel slag roller crushing and waste heat recovery technology. Production methods include digital and intelligent manufacturing with automated assembly lines and lean production management.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are primarily large industrial enterprises in power generation (thermal power plants), heat supply, chemical, metallurgy, and waste treatment sectors. The company serves major state-owned power groups and steel enterprises, with sales mainly through public bidding and direct contracts. It also targets emerging markets in clean energy consumption and flexible power generation.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly within China, with significant sales in East China, North China, Central South, Northwest, Southwest, Northeast, Hong Kong, Macau, Taiwan, and overseas markets. Its registered office and main production facilities are located in Qingdao, Shandong Province.
categories.supply_chain_position: Qingdao Daneng operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on the design, manufacturing, and installation of environmental protection equipment. It procures raw materials and components from upstream suppliers and delivers finished products and systems directly to end customers in industrial sectors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation and R&D investment, focusing on energy-saving and emission reduction technologies, including flue gas deep cooling, slag treatment, desulfurization wastewater zero discharge, and clean energy consumption systems. It actively develops hydrogen energy technologies and flexible power generation solutions. R&D efforts emphasize proprietary core technologies, patent development, and collaboration with universities and research institutes.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of customized environmental protection equipment and systems, including engineering procurement (EP) and engineering procurement construction (EPC) contracts. The company also earns income from after-sales services, spare parts sales, and technical consulting. Sales are predominantly direct to industrial customers via bidding and contract agreements.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a strong competitive position in the energy-saving and environmental protection equipment sector, recognized as a high-tech innovator with multiple national and provincial awards. It competes with other specialized environmental equipment manufacturers and EPC contractors in the power, steel, and chemical industries. Its proprietary technologies and comprehensive product portfolio provide a competitive edge, especially in flue gas and slag treatment solutions.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, Qingdao Daneng achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.03 billion, a 35% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 86.68 million, up 48%. The company’s total assets reached RMB 1.93 billion, and net assets attributable to shareholders were RMB 879 million, reflecting steady growth and expanding scale. R&D investment accounted for nearly 5% of revenue, underscoring its growth through innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes advanced, proprietary technologies that enhance energy efficiency, reduce emissions, and enable comprehensive waste heat recovery. Its products offer high reliability, customization, and integration across solid, liquid, and gas waste treatment. Innovations like the smoke-water dual isolation phase-change cooler and steel slag roller crushing system differentiate it by solving industry bottlenecks, improving operational safety, and enabling zero discharge wastewater treatment, thereby delivering superior environmental and economic benefits to customers.
